assumptions.provenance: SYNTHETIC - generated by terrapulse.data.synthetic; not real observations.
assumptions.purpose: Exercise preprocessing, grouped validation, imbalance handling, reporting and UI.
structure: N event groups (default 8), each a spatial cluster of samples around a random centre inside an approximate Solukhumbu bounding box. Event IDs are SYN-EVT-xx and do not correspond to real events.
Events are assigned whole to train or test (train_test_group) so splits are by group.
terrain: Elevation ~ event base (3000-4800 m) + N(0, 450 m); slope ~ N(28, 11) deg clipped to 0-75.
TWI decreases with slope; distances to river/road are log-normal.
environment: Rainfall is cumulative by construction (1d <= 3d <= 7d <= 30d) with an event-level storm intensity.
Soil moisture increases with 7-day rainfall; NDVI decreases with elevation.
Land cover is derived from elevation and NDVI; geology is sampled with elevation-dependent weights.
label_mechanism: Latent susceptibility logit = slope bump (peak ~35 deg) + rainfall + soil moisture - NDVI - log distance to river + geology effect - curvature + event random effect + noise.
Intercept is solved numerically so the expected positive rate is ~9% (class imbalance).
~2% of labels are flipped, preferentially where label_confidence is low (label noise).
sar_signal: Post-event SAR features are generated CONDITIONAL on the label to emulate a detectable change signal: positives get larger |backscatter difference|, lower coherence, and larger negative LOS displacement. This is a modelling assumption, not a physical result.
C-band-like rows carry VV/VH only (HH/HV missing); L-band-like rows carry HH/HV only.
assumptions.target_derived: Severity, area, displacement and change_classification are derived from the label AFTER sampling; they are post-event quantities and must never be predictors.
